claims.quote: Our rock-solid support to Ukraine is vital for keeping us safe here in the UK
claims.statement: UK support for Ukraine is vital for keeping the UK safe.

claims.quote: we are with you for as long as it takes
claims.statement: The UK is with Ukraine for as long as it takes.

claims.quote: Russia’s aggression cannot be allowed to succeed on our continent.
claims.statement: Russia's aggression cannot be allowed to succeed in Europe.

claims.quote: I urge partners to back the ban on Russian LNG, like we have done in the UK
claims.statement: Partners should back a ban on Russian LNG as the UK has done.

claims.quote: our commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable
claims.statement: The UK's commitment to the Ukrainian people is unshakeable.

claims.made_by: Chancellor of the Exchequer John Healey
claims.quote: the Chancellor will argue that this must be met by European resolve and unity
claims.statement: Russia's bombardment must be met by European resolve and unity.

facts.quote: Prime Minister to host President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at Downing Street today
facts.statement: The Prime Minister is hosting President Volodymyr Zelenskyy at Downing Street on the day of publication.

facts.quote: including delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles deliveries
facts.statement: The UK is delivering £45 million of surface-to-air missiles to Ukraine.

facts.quote: The UK has already committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5000 LMMs to Ukraine over the next four years
facts.statement: The UK has committed £1.6 billion to deliver more than 5,000 Lightweight Multirole Missiles to Ukraine over four years.

facts.quote: The Prime Minister has also asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid, and fiscal packages
facts.statement: The Prime Minister has asked Ministers to draw up further sanctions, military aid and fiscal packages.

facts.quote: will accelerate £10 million of the £45m package of missiles announced today
facts.statement: The UK will accelerate £10 million of the £45 million missile package.

facts.quote: the Foreign Secretary did the same with partners at the Warsaw Security Forum yesterday [TUE]
facts.statement: The Foreign Secretary urged partners at the Warsaw Security Forum to implement an equivalent ban on Russian LNG.

facts.quote: Chancellor John Healey will use his meetings at the IMF in Bangkok
facts.statement: Chancellor John Healey is holding meetings at the IMF in Bangkok.

facts.quote: As Russia continues its bombardment of Ukraine’s capital Kyiv and energy infrastructure
facts.statement: Russia is continuing its bombardment of Kyiv and Ukraine's energy infrastructure.
